notes: Improvement rounds (engine now skips thin sessions, so the re-run baseline was MAIN 184 trades / PF 1.44 / Sharpe 1.63, PRIOR 163 / PF 1.16). Kept: trend_fast=50 (prior NDX close must be on the same side of SMA50 AND SMA200): MAIN 142 trades, net +6,217, PF 1.72, Sharpe 2.12, 72.5% pos days, maxDD -1,212, largest day 5.7% of net; PRIOR 117 trades, net +1,301, PF 1.22, Sharpe 0.69. trend_fast 20/50 plateau, 100 weaker on PRIOR. Rejected: breakeven/trail (MAIN PF 1.21-1.31), time stop 60/120/240 min (MAIN net down, PRIOR up), re-entry (PF 1.36, deeper DD), stop cap 0.3/0.45 ATR (MAIN PF 1.53/1.67, Lucid worse), overnight-range >= 0.4 ATR (MAIN PF 1.80 but net -8% and Lucid exp net 1,576 vs 2,144; PRIOR PF 1.48 -> robust alternative). Lucid 50K Flex (MAIN daily): 5 micros pass 0.63, P(first payout) 0.42 uncond, exp net +2,144/eval, median 25.5 days; 10 micros pass 0.38, P(payout) 0.23, exp net +1,411, median 11 days (scan's best by bootstrap lower bound); no size is 'recommended' (lower bounds -68/-105 < 0). Monthly pass-within-21-sessions rates are uneven (0 to 1.0 by start month). MES positive on MAIN (PF 1.20) but PF 0.68 on PRIOR -> dead; MGC dead (earlier grid). | WALK-FORWARD ASSESSMENT 2026-10-03 (results/orb_close30/walkforward.json): OOS 2025-01..2026-09 = 140 trades, net +3,870, PF 1.45, Sharpe 1.42, 71% pos days, 15/21 pos months, maxDD -1,076, vs fixed in-sample MAIN PF 1.72 (in-sample overstates PF by ~0.27 and net by ~38%). Lucid on the OOS stream: 5 micros, pass 0.50, pass_within_21 only 0.13, median 43.5 days to pass, P(first payout) 0.20, exp net +445/eval but exp_net_lb -146 = zero_edge -146 -> NOT recommended. Caveats: (1) 82% of OOS net is Jan-Jun 2026 (Jun-26 alone 28%); calendar 2025 OOS is only +1,342; the last three OOS quarters are PF 1.07 / 1.03 / 0.64. (2) 2023-2024 OOS folds are +1,684 total but 5/8 negative and -694 without the 2024Q3 fold. (3) Base params trend_fast=50, max_range_atr=0.5, max_stop_atr=0.6 were chosen on MAIN and sit outside GRID, so the WF only re-selects or_minutes/direction/stop_mode/tgt_frac; the OOS is partially contaminated. (4) Far-side stop: avg loss -214 vs avg win +124 needs >63% win; 0.31 trades/day is too slow for a 21-session pass. Gate passed (PF >= 1.03 with >= 40 trades) -> proceed, as a thin portfolio leg, not a stand-alone account strategy.

Non-GRID values trend_fast 50 / max_range_atr 0.5 / max_stop_atr 0.6 were chosen on MAIN (snooping, not look-ahead).
